title: Pfister Contempra LG49-NCPB Widespread Bathroom Faucet, Matte Black

comparisons.notes: Same Pfister LG49-NCPB matte black, UPC 038877670354; listed 45 in stock

writeup: Pfister's Contempra LG49-NCPB is a two-handle widespread bathroom faucet in matte black with a 1.2 GPM WaterSense flow rate, ceramic-disc Pforever Seal valves, Pfast Connect supply lines and an included Push & Seal pop-up drain. Woot has it new for $125.99, while plumbing dealers list the same model from about $320 to $385. Only one was showing at posting time.
